pages.title: Tools
pages.line: Tools from my research, and a few others. They run in your browser; nothing you draw, measure or upload leaves your device.

pages.title: Unit-cell designer
pages.line: Design a periodic microstructure for a target stiffness, then export it for cutting or printing.

pages.title: Cell sketchpad
pages.line: Draw a unit cell and see its stiffness and Poisson’s ratio at once. Can you draw an auxetic?

pages.title: Property map
pages.line: Hundreds of optimized unit cells on one chart of stiffness against Poisson’s ratio. Pick one to see it.

pages.title: Truss sizing
pages.line: A genetic algorithm sizes every member of a steel truss, trading steel mass against deflection and the number of different sections.

pages.title: Multi-criteria choice
pages.line: Rank a few options on several criteria with TOPSIS and VIKOR, weigh the criteria directly or by AHP, and see with SMAA-2 how the ranking holds when the weights are uncertain.

pages.title: Phone vibrometer
pages.line: Lay your phone on a desk, a floor or a footbridge and read its natural frequency.

pages.title: World map generator
pages.line: A world map with the countries you pick highlighted and labelled, in your projection and colours, ready as SVG or PNG.

pages.title: Gauge
pages.line: A dial for one value on a colour scale, with your own range, title and unit, ready as SVG or PNG.
